evaluation_day.description: The day the brief is about (= brief_day, = norm evaluation_day, AD-9).

collected_at.description: finished_at of the last SUCCEEDED collect/backfill run (AD-7).

revenue.description: Money as a string with exactly two decimal places (AD-10).

actual.description: Null when the evaluated day has no fact version at all (status blocked). Absence is written as null, never as a missing key, for the same reason as norm and deviation_pct.

orders.description: Median of orders as a string with two decimals - mirrors norm_daily.value numeric(14,2) (AD-8/AD-10); fractional part is legitimate for an even sample.

revenue.description: Money as a string with exactly two decimal places (AD-10).

window_days.description: D21: median of the last 14 full days before evaluation_day.

norm.description: Null when the day has no usable norm: no version for evaluation_day (status blocked) or an incomplete window (status insufficient). Absence is written as null, never as a missing key - a reader must be able to tell 'not computed' from 'not looked at'. The trustworthiness of a non-null value is carried by brief_daily.status, not by the payload.

orders.description: (yesterday - norm) / norm * 100 for orders. Calculation conventions (D27): rounded to 0.1 of a percentage point exactly once, at the last step after the division; intermediates keep full precision.

revenue.description: (yesterday - norm) / norm * 100 for revenue. Calculation conventions (D27): rounded to 0.1 of a percentage point exactly once, at the last step after the division; intermediates keep full precision.

deviation_pct.description: Null when the day has no usable norm: no version for evaluation_day (status blocked) or an incomplete window (status insufficient). Absence is written as null, never as a missing key - a reader must be able to tell 'not computed' from 'not looked at'. The trustworthiness of a non-null value is carried by brief_daily.status, not by the payload.

signals.description: Anomalies ranked by money (AD-10 signal v1); empty until M-04 (AD-9).

source_refs.description: Evidence pointers (AD-1) behind the brief: fact versions, norm rows, artifacts; never empty.

reason.description: Why the day carries no norm. Present only when the brief is blocked.
